title: Here Come the Big People #1 Event Comics 1997 Amanda Conner Palmiotti Beaulieu
conditionDescription: Bright cover with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Here Come the Big People #1 (1997), Event Comics one-shot. Written by Trace Beaulieu (Mystery Science Theater 3000), cover and art by Amanda Conner and Jimmy Palmiotti. $2.95 cover price.

Back cover: Ash #1 ad (Robinson, Quesada, Palmiotti).

Condition: bright cover with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
